title: 12 January 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the 16th night of Another Beatles Christmas Show, which ran from 24 December 1964 to 16 January 1965 at London’s Hammersmith Odeon.

There were two shows on this night, with guest performers including Freddie And The Dreamers, Sounds Incorporated, Elkie Brooks, The Yardbirds, Michael Haslam, The Mike Cotton Sound and Ray Fell. The compère was Jimmy Savile.

The Beatles appeared in two sketches, one with Freddie Garrity of Freddie And The Dreamers, and another with Jimmy Savile. They closed the shows with an 11-song set: ‘Twist And Shout’, ‘I’m A Loser’, ‘Baby’s In Black’, ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, ‘Honey Don’t’, ‘I Feel Fine’, ‘She’s A Woman’, ‘A Hard Day’s Night’, ‘Rock And Roll Music’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 13 October 2021

  • 1978: Mixing: Girlfriend by Wings
  • 1977: Recording: Tango All Night by Ringo Starr
  • 1976: Recording: Wino Junko by Wings
  • 1974: John Lennon watches Ann Peebles perform in Los Angeles
  • 1969: The Beatles meet at Ringo Starr’s house
  • 1968: Apple Music Ltd. becomes Apple Corps Ltd.
  • 1968: Recording: The Inner Light, Wonderwall Music
  • 1967: Recording, mixing: Penny Lane
  • 1967: Joe Orton is asked to write a film script for The Beatles
  • 1966: John Lennon and Ringo Starr holiday in Trinidad
  • 1964: Sunday Night At The London Palladium
  • 1963: The Beatles live: Invicta Ballroom, Chatham
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Tower Ballroom, New Brighton, Wallasey
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
